## Who this is for

Hiring managers and programme leads who need someone to take Microsoft Copilot Studio or Azure AI Foundry from discovery through Purview controls, PEN-test gates, human-in-the-loop review, and controlled go-live — not demoware that dies as shadow IT.

## What Shiel delivers

- Enterprise AI delivery: Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Purview, Power Platform
- Lifecycle: discovery → pilot → harden → controlled go-live → continuous improvement
- Governance: UK GDPR, PEN testing gates, audit-ready risk documentation, human-in-the-loop
- Hands-on build: React/TypeScript products on Google Cloud, Railway, and related stacks

## Selected proof (live products)

- Tribunal Ally — Gemini on Cloud Run employment tribunal case-file product (Firebase Auth/Firestore/Storage; human-confirmed extracts; Acas/GOV.UK grounding; soft launch)
- Employee Ally — related employment dispute preparation with the same HITL discipline
- DealTable WebMCP — negotiation tool-calling with mandate/walkaway safeguards
- GhostMerchant — buyer-side PayPal escrow control plane for autonomous agents
- GridRecord — AI-assisted energy operations / reporting
- Countermark, ComplaintPath, UNDO, Truce — additional governed / agentic prototypes
